content.text:
Done. The single `<MASKED>` region in `src/main/java/com/dbconsole/platform/service/InstanceService.java` is reconstructed and verified end-to-end.

**What was implemented** (using only the retained imports — `java.net.*` covers `Socket`/`HttpURLConnection`, no new imports needed):

- **CRUD** — `createInstance` maps all request fields, sets `status="CREATED"`, `ownerId`, and both timestamps, then `insert` (XML writes the generated key back to `id`). `getInstance`/`updateInstance`/`deleteInstance` return `null`/`"NOT_FOUND"` for missing records and for non-admin callers touching records they don't own (indistinguishable from missing). `listInstances` calls `findByFilters(ownerId, dbType, groupId, isAdmin)`. `updateInstance` applies only non-null request fields (never `dbType`/`status`/`ownerId`), sets `updatedAt`, persists, returns the entity.
- **pingInstance** — dispatches on stored `dbType`: `MYSQL`/`REDIS` do a TCP `Socket.connect` with 5000 ms timeout (`主机或端口为空` when host/port null, `连接成功` + elapsed ms on connect, `连接超时` on failure); `OSS` issues an in-JVM HTTP GET via `HttpURLConnection` to `http(s)://<host>/<schemaName>` (null schema → empty resource) with 5000 ms connect/read timeouts (`连接成功，状态码: <n>` for any HTTP status, `连接超时` on failure, and a no-contact detail when host is empty); anything else → `不支持的实例类型`. Result map keys are exactly `reachable`/`latencyMs`/`detail`.

**Verification performed**: `rm -rf target && mvn package -DskipTests` builds cleanly and produces `target/platform-1.0.0.jar`. I launched the jar on 8080 against the local MySQL and exercised the full flow over HTTP: login as seeded `user1`, create group, create instances, and ping — OSS against a live local HTTP mock returned `连接成功，状态码: 200` (null schema) and `404` (with schema), MYSQL to port 3306 returned `连接成功` with `latencyMs`, closed port and unreachable host returned `连接超时` within the timeout bound, null port returned `主机或端口为空`, unknown type returned `不支持的实例类型`. List filtering, get/update/delete, and cross-user 404 behavior (user2 on user1's instance, including the ping route) all matched the contract. All test processes were stopped, smoke-test data was removed (database reset), and no files outside the target file were modified.
